pattern: A "does it do X" about something the company sells is answered from What we sell, read in the turn
experience: The owner's sales team need Kin to know the company's products in depth; an agent answering from memory says yes to what the product doesn't do (design 8.2, mechanism 3).

outline.title: Who is a good customer for us
What people worry about and what we say

sections.title: What it does
sections.text:
### What it does

Stock, orders and picking in one place, on a computer or a phone.

sections.title: Price
sections.text:
### Price

€380 a month per warehouse, setup from €6,000. A single-site start is priced per site.

sections.title: What it doesn't do
sections.text:
### What it doesn't do

Payroll or accounts; it sends invoices to their accounting package.

sections.title: What people worry about and what we say
sections.text:
### What people worry about and what we say

- "Our last system failed." Start with one site for eight weeks; agree the measure first.
- "Our staff won't cope." Two training days on site; the phone screen for picking.

sections.title: Proof
sections.text:
### Proof

Bramble Joinery: live in six weeks after a failed system (may be named).
